research_assumptions.policy: Cost-aware funded paired transfers; inherited legacy gradual allocation/scoring parameters are retained for reference but do not drive paired transfer decisions.
research_assumptions.parameter_changes: Same June 16–26 scored period, 0.5-second decisions, three 100ms delays, fees and funding as the matched adaptive ten-day baseline. Empirical execution mode calibrates only on the preceding ten days, June 6–16, then freezes the model for the scored run.
research_assumptions.preserved_reference_settings: 100% BTC, regular/linear long-only futures, 100% maximum tape participation, 60-second quote age, zero custody expense, zero half spread and zero slippage. Legacy allocation/scoring fields are copied unchanged. The legacy execution delay stays zero and is overridden by the explicit paired order delay.
research_assumptions.period: [2026-06-16T00:00:00, 2026-06-26T00:00:00) UTC; 10 scored days; 1728000 scheduled decision boundaries.
research_assumptions.fee_estimate: 10 basis points (0.10%) of executed USD notional per buy or sell on both spot and futures. Existing opening BTC is an endowment, not a newly charged purchase.

fee_sources.rate: Regular-user spot maker/taker 0.100%; no BNB or VIP discount.
Standard futures maker 0.015%, taker 0.035%; nonweekly delivery 0.025%, weekly delivery exempt.

research_assumptions.fee_model_limitation: The current paired engine shares one proportional rate across spot and futures. Applying 10 bp to futures is conservative relative to the published current 3.5 bp taker rate; this is not a reconstructed historical account-tier schedule. Fixed/minimum/per-unit fees remain zero. Expiry delivery fees and cross-venue transfer/FX costs are unmodeled.
research_assumptions.execution: Empirical completion-deadline repricing for fully funded spot-to-futures entry, with a 95% historical execution-confidence target and at least 100 calibration samples. Historical eligible same-side tape volume limits staged partial fills. Funding, expected net BTC versus KEEP and the execution deadline still constrain trades. No executable order-book depth or venue queue position is reconstructed.
research_assumptions.forecast: Conditional expected net BTC versus KEEP: flat expected spot, residual futures basis fades linearly toward the configured settlement basis at expiry, latest available cash yield held constant, common horizons bounded by expiry.
research_assumptions.funding: Fully funded USD-linear research proxy, causal cash-interest proxy and scheduled variation settlement; no leverage or native inverse settlement.
research_assumptions.data: Binance BTC/USDT with assumed USDT/USD parity and Deribit inverse USD quote observations as a linear-futures price proxy.
research_assumptions.validation: Ten scored days with strictly earlier, frozen calibration. Compare against the matched adaptive ten-day baseline. Completion probability includes failed attempts; empirical confidence is a research target and does not guarantee execution or profit.

latency.assumption: Synthetic latency assumptions, not measured historical exchange delays. The common observation delay is added to instrument-specific feed delays; explicit paired order delay overrides the legacy execution delay. Replacements take effect after their decision and order delays.

research_assumptions.validation_period: Ten scored days [2026-06-16, 2026-06-26) UTC, with a frozen empirical calibration from the preceding ten days [2026-06-06, 2026-06-16).
research_assumptions.comparison_role: Empirical completion-deadline policy with 100 ms per delay stage, compared with the same-period adaptive baseline; frozen calibration uses only earlier historical data.

execution_study.causality: Calibration observations and completed outcome labels must precede the scored run. No test-period refitting. Partial, failed and cutoff-censored attempts are retained in diagnostics.
execution_study.units: Price-basis slippage is in basis points. Annualized lease slippage uses the original cohort maturity; waiting time is not the annualization denominator.
execution_study.limitation: Tape participation is a research execution proxy; the fitted confidence target is not an execution guarantee.
